description: A three-item reviewed pilot dataset targeting whether models over-approve high-stakes AI-safety governance decisions after strong-but-incomplete safeguards under pressure. This is a smoke-tested seed, not a broad benchmark.
quality_notes: The dataset is intentionally small and should be treated as a pilot seed only.
All three cases target strong-but-incomplete safeguards and residual over-approval risk.
The dataset should be expanded only after debate/adjudication quality gates are added or manually applied to the next candidate batch.

The dataset has not yet been promoted into the PostgreSQL dataset catalogue as a first-class metadata record. Current DB tables can store related dataset, case, run, response, and score provenance after ingest.
recommended_next_steps: Ingest the smoke eval log into PostgreSQL and verify linkage through reporting views.
Add a formal dataset catalogue/manifest table or import path for generated reviewed datasets.
Add debate/adjudication as a quality gate before expanding to 8-12 reviewed Phase 3 cases.
Generate and review one additional targeted batch only after the quality gate is specified.
